history.compatibility: Breaking for SourceConnector only: classify(item): SourceSensitivity is removed and replaced by classificationSignals(item): SourceClassificationSignals (source facts only; the shared four-tier classifier decides). Every in-tree connector moved in the same change. EvidencePack (1.1.0, optional coverage matchCounts) and Analyst shapes are unchanged by this version. Storage placement is unchanged: each lane declares the placement its connector's classify() returned (ConnectorStoreSyncOptions.placement), so no item moves and no vector changes.
history.migrationReceipt: docs/CONTRACTS.md change log 2026-09-23 (SourceConnector 2.0.0): no stored-data migration in this version. Declared-placement lanes keep every row and vector: test/tier-p1a-storage-unchanged.test.ts proves byte-identical items, chunks and vectors with and without the tier ledger, and that re-syncing never re-embeds or reaches invalidateEmbeddingModelCurrency; test/tier-p1a-review-fixes.test.ts pins per-lane parity with the retired classify() answers. Gmail and Drive keep the shared raise-only classification policy; their re-fetch path now uses that policy instead of the connector's own classify(), so there the guarantee is the unchanged policy, not byte identity. The tier ledger is a new, additive SQLite file co-located with each store and covered by data delete. Moving items between tier stores is phase P1b (design section 4.6, owner-approved batches).
history.evalReceipt: Held-out eval NOT run for this version: it needs a live corpus and analyst, and this change touches no retrieval, EvidencePack or Analyst path. Offline receipts that did run: contract freeze, the eval harness unit suites (eval-harness, eval-real, eval-diagnose, eval-process-boundary), the new tier-classifier precedence and source-agnostic suites, and the P1a storage-invariance suite. The design's classification eval (secret recall, Private leakage) arrives with the sniffer in P2. A reviewer may require an exact-head held-out run before merge.

history.compatibility: Additive and optional (docs/design/child-items.md): SourceItemIdentity.parent, RawItem.deferredBytes (locator, available, sizeBytes), a second optional argument to SourceConnector.fetchItem carrying the persisted locator, and SourceCitationMetadata.parentLabel. A connector that omits them, and a consumer that ignores them, behave as under 2.0.0; a fetchItem that takes one argument still satisfies the interface. A child is an item of its own with its own two tiers: no tier is inherited from its parent, and a child never raises its parent. EvidencePack and Analyst shapes are otherwise unchanged; the Analyst prompt is unchanged and no question logic is added.
history.migrationReceipt: docs/CONTRACTS.md change log 2026-10-25 (SourceConnector and EvidencePack 2.1.0). The connector store gains four nullable items columns (parent_local_item_id, deferred_locator, bytes_available, size_bytes) and an index on the parent as an additive schema migration; existing rows have no parent and do not move. test/child-items-storage-unchanged.test.ts proves existing items, chunks and vectors are byte-identical before and after the migration, following test/tier-p1a-storage-unchanged.test.ts. The tier ledger gains the parent key and a durable cascade queue; the archive record gains an append-only media-binding table (a SQLite file beside the record, raw/archive-media-bindings.sqlite, written before the child row and not hashed into a resume point); the extraction job store gains a forget step by (corpus, account scope). No embedding model or epoch changes: children are new items, embedded as any new item is.
history.evalReceipt: The fixture held-out harness (test/eval-harness.test.ts, test/eval-child-items.test.ts) gains cases whose answer exists only inside a child, where the cited child must name its parent. Offline, with a fixture connector; no format connector is touched in this step. The instantiated private held-out run (bun run eval:real) needs the owner-private dataset and a hydrated connector store, which the implementing machine does not have; per docs/design/child-items.md it is a merge precondition of the spine pull request and is recorded as open on it.
